name: Replatform Pipeline
description: Migrates a workload with minor optimisations, such as moving to a managed database service or containerising the application layer.

tasks.name: Assessment & Target Architecture Review
tasks.description: Architect reviews the source workload and confirms target architecture decisions (e.g. RDS vs self-managed DB).

tasks.name: Provision Target Infrastructure
tasks.description: Deploy target infrastructure using IaC templates (e.g. CloudFormation, Terraform, or ARM).

tasks.name: Migrate Data to Managed Service
tasks.description: Stream or bulk-load data from the source database to the target managed database service.

tasks.name: Deploy Application to Target
tasks.description: Deploy application artefacts to the target compute layer (container image, VM image, or PaaS).

tasks.name: Smoke Test in Target Environment
tasks.description: Run automated smoke and integration tests against the target deployment.

tasks.name: User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
tasks.description: Application owner performs UAT on the target environment.

tasks.name: DNS Cutover
tasks.description: Update DNS records to point to the new target environment.

tasks.name: Decommission Source Environment
tasks.description: After a stabilisation period, schedule source workload for decommission.
